   `git -C "$WORKTREE" push --no-follow-tags --force-with-lease=fix-timeout:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix-timeout`
   The push succeeded and I saved P.

- `C=cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`

All verification, conformance, and clean-tree gates passed. Start ship tracking. Before stripping anything, retain `test-timeout`, accepted-complete task evidence, thread attribution, and the artifact’s path-only Spec header: `doc/specs/rework.md`.

### Checkpoint: rebase push proof and threads

Run the following proofs before landing:

```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" fetch origin
git -C "$WORKTREE" merge-base --is-ancestor "$B" HEAD
git -C "$WORKTREE" rev-parse origin/fix-timeout
```

The ancestry proof passes at `C`; origin equals `A`, so select the **lease push**. Original-prehead ancestry is not required for this rebase route.

Refresh PR #42’s threads using the prescribed paginated thread/comment queries. T1 remains open. Count its naming commits over the **rework-base range**, not the original-prehead range:

```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" log --first-parent --format=%h \
  --grep 'T1' "$B"..HEAD
```

Exactly one match, `ddddddd`, plus the accepted-complete task evidence yields **`fixed in ddddddd`**. Do not mark the GitHub thread resolved or reply to it.

### Checkpoint: strip → seal → push → body

1. Remove tracked paired task-plan and ledger candidates, committing removals; preserve the spec and telemetry.
2. Seal before pushing:

```bash
node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs \
  --worktree "$WORKTREE" --option pr \
  --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md
```

Seal succeeds. Retain its actual stdout verbatim for completion. Preserve the existing `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42`; it already equals `A`.

3. Push with exactly these flags:

```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" push --no-follow-tags \
  --force-with-lease=fix-timeout:"$A" \
  origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix-timeout
```

Save the successfully pushed full HEAD. Below, `<pushed HEAD7>` means its seven-character abbreviation, captured **after** strip/seal—not automatically `ccccccc`.

4. **Only after successful push**, fetch the current body:

```bash
gh pr view 42 -R acme/widget --json body
```

Decode JSON without trimming or shell command substitution. Create an outside-repository scratch file with `mktemp`; write the original bytes `Original description\n` unchanged, append one blank line, then this block:

```markdown
## Rework

Before: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42` in the rework checkout)
Spec: doc/specs/rework.md at <pushed HEAD7>

Changes: repair timeout
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-timeout; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.

- T1 - fixed in ddddddd
```

No thread location was supplied; none is invented.

Edit using that complete scratch body:

```bash
gh pr edit 42 -R acme/widget --body-file "$scratch"
```

Retain `Original description\n` byte-for-byte. Change the block’s second line to:

```text

```

Replace `Dropped claims: none` with `Dropped claims:` followed by one `No longer true: <claim>` line per actual dropped claim; claim text was not supplied.

After successful body edit, complete ship tracking and report the seal stdout. No thread replies, merges, member closure, ticket changes, or worktree cleanup.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Before stops at the merge-mode proof (`merge-base --is-ancestor PRE HEAD` exits 1), declares `Rework base:` unread, never offers row 1, and so never captures evidence, counts `B..HEAD`, pushes, or edits the body; every fact fails there. After delivers the Change: it detects rebase mode from `Rework base:`, proves `B` ancestry, checks `origin/fix-timeout == A` before selecting the exact `--no-follow-tags --force-with-lease=fix-timeout:A origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix-timeout` push, preserves the existing pre-rework ref without update-ref, captures accepted-complete evidence before strip/seal, counts first-parent `B..HEAD` to `ddddddd`, seals `--option pr --base origin/main`, fetches the body after push with `gh pr view 42 --json body`, writes exact bytes plus blank line plus block to an outside-repo mktemp scratch, edits with `--body-file "$SCRATCH"`, and renders the full-SHA/local-ref Before line plus the supersedes/No-longer-true variant without replacing original bytes. Two wording nits to tighten so the body fact is matched literally rather than by alias: spell the repo flag as `--repo acme/widget` (not `-R`) on both the FETCH and EDIT invocations, and render the Spec head as the concrete pushed SHA alias (e.g. `at P`) rather than the `<P7>` placeholder so the spec/head conjunct is unambiguous; otherwise the After wording keeps everything Before kept (provenance, no replies/merge/closure/ticket changes, preserved worktree and ref) while adding the rebase-mode landing.
